style.Product tabs: padding: 0px max(40px, calc((100% - 1350px) / 2)); background: #FFFFFF; border-width: 0px 0px 1px 0px; border-style: solid; border-color: #E6E0D6; @media(--tablet){ padding: 0px 40px; } @media(--mobile){ padding: 0px 20px; }
style.Product tabs track: padding: 0px; gap: 8px; justify-content: space-between; align-items: stretch; @media(--tablet){ gap: 28px; } @media(--mobile){ gap: 22px; }
style.Tab All: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 1.2px; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.2; color: #16213A; padding: 22px 0px 20px 0px; border-width: 0px 0px 2px 0px; border-style: solid; border-color: transparent; transition: color 0.3s; &:hover{ color: #C9962E; } @media(--mobile){ padding: 18px 0px 16px 0px; }
